Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Patients at high-risk for an acute myocardial infarction, including any 2 of these risk factors: males age > 45; females age >55; family history of premature coronary heart disease (CHD); current cigarette smoker; hypertension; or elevated total cholesterol with low HDL and/or high LDL.
Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: Patient is male age 58 (>45), has elevated LDL (>190 mg/dL) with no mention of HDL/LDL specifics, and family history of premature CHD (father died at 62).

Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: OR have: Active angina (chest pain due to coronary heart disease) - History of coronary heart disease according to the treating physician - Past history of myocardial infarction documented by electrocardiogram or arteriography - Diabetes Mellitus - Renal dialysis
Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: Patient has documented past history of myocardial infarctions and active coronary artery disease with impaired left ventricular function.

Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: No explicit information about recent hospitalization timelines.

Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Persons living in a home with previously enrolled patients
Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: No mention of household members or shared living arrangements.

Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Patients disoriented to person, place, or time at onset of study
Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: No evidence of disorientation or cognitive impairment in patient history.

Recap: Patient meets inclusion criteria via multiple high-risk factors and documented MI history. Exclusion criteria are either not violated or lack sufficient data to confirm.
